description: Governed entry point for the standalone Connecticut OEC active Child Care Center acquisition and offline normalization app.
redirect_policy: Fixed official metadata and SODA2 endpoints; redirects rejected and credentials omitted. Retained-input mode performs no network requests.
retry: No automatic source retry or job restart. Preserve completed acquisitions for explicit offline reuse.
checkpoint: Persist the app start before acquisition, then verified acquisition and normalization references, publish the terminal receipt, independently replay it, and atomically advance the governed current pointer last.
idempotency: Immutable UUID-scoped app and child releases; explicitly verified retained inputs avoid repulling, no historical release is overwritten, and a failed run leaves the prior governed pointer unchanged.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing, drain owned writers, retain completed child evidence, and require inspection for uncertain ownership.
retention_profile: Internal source candidates and immutable linked receipts. ZIP5 and ZIP4 remain separate; coordinates remain null; no business polygons or public record export.
